author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
You drew it once. Now see it from every direction with Turntable in #AdobeIllustrator — no redrawing required! 

In this tutorial, we'll cover how to: 
- Turn one illustration into 74 distinct perspectives 
- Add vertical tilt to explore top-down and bottom-up views you never originally drew
- Scan every generated angle on your artboard and grab the one that fits your project
- Export all views as a looping animated GIF — ready for social, presentations, and marketing

If you're a character designer, product illustrator, or motion graphics creator, be sure to try this out in your workflow! 

What kind of artwork would you spin first — a character, a product, or something else? Comment below and save this tutorial for your next design.

Contents of this video:
00:01 Intro and meet author Kaleb Gonyea
00:33 Generate alternate angles from your illustration
01:28 Place all views and choose the best perspective
02:20 Export an animated GIF in one click
